SELECT , CAT.CATEGORY_NAME, S.SUPPLIER_NAME, SUM(OD.QUANTITY) AS UNITS_SOLD, SUM(OD.QUANTITY * OD.UNIT_PRICE) AS REVENUE, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PRODUCT_REVIEW R WHERE R.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID) AS REVIEW_COUNT, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY CAT.CATEGORY_ID ORDER BY SUM(OD.QUANTITY * OD.UNIT_PRICE) DESC) AS REVENUE_RANK FROM PRODUCT P INNER JOIN ORDER_DETAIL OD ON OD.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID INNER JOIN ORDERS O ON O.ORDER_ID = OD.ORDER_ID LEFT JOIN CATEGORY CAT ON CAT.CATEGORY_ID = P.CATEGORY_ID LEFT JOIN SUPPLIER S ON S.SUPPLIER_ID = P.SUPPLIER_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT RT.PRODUCT_ID, SUM(RT.RETURN_QTY) AS RETURNED FROM RETURN_ITEM RT WHERE RT.RETURN_DATE >= #since# GROUP BY RT.PRODUCT_ID ) RET ON RET.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID WHERE O.STATUS = 'COMPLETED'
P.CATEGORY_ID = #categoryId#
P.SUPPLIER_ID = #supplierId#
O.ORDER_DATE >= #since#
GROUP BY P.PRODUCT_ID, P.PRODUCT_NAME, P.PRICE, P.STATUS, CAT.CATEGORY_ID, CAT.CATEGORY_NAME, S.SUPPLIER_NAME
SUM(OD.QUANTITY) >= #minUnits#
SUM(OD.QUANTITY * OD.UNIT_PRICE) >= #minRevenue#
ORDER BY REVENUE DESC

SELECT C.CUSTOMER_ID, C.CUSTOMER_NAME, (SELECT MAX(O.ORDER_DATE) FROM ORDERS O WHERE O.CUSTOMER_ID = C.CUSTOMER_ID) AS lastOrderDate, P1.TOTAL_PAYMENT AS totalPayment, P1.PAYMENT_COUNT AS paymentCount FROM CUSTOMER C LEFT JOIN ( SELECT PM.CUSTOMER_ID, SUM(PM.PAYMENT_AMOUNT) AS TOTAL_PAYMENT, COUNT(*) AS PAYMENT_COUNT FROM PAYMENT PM WHERE PM.ORDER_ID IN (SELECT OD.ORDER_ID FROM ORDER_DETAIL OD WHERE OD.QUANTITY > 0) GROUP BY PM.CUSTOMER_ID ) P1 ON P1.CUSTOMER_ID = C.CUSTOMER_ID
C.REGION_CODE = #regionCode#
P1.TOTAL_PAYMENT >= #minPayment#
ORDER BY P1.TOTAL_PAYMENT DESC

SELECT 'ONLINE' AS CHANNEL, COUNT(*) AS ORDER_COUNT, SUM(ON_O.TOTAL_AMOUNT) AS AMOUNT FROM ONLINE_ORDER ON_O WHERE ON_O.ORDER_DATE >= #since# UNION ALL SELECT 'OFFLINE' AS CHANNEL, COUNT(*) AS ORDER_COUNT, SUM(OFF_O.TOTAL_AMOUNT) AS AMOUNT FROM OFFLINE_ORDER OFF_O WHERE OFF_O.ORDER_DATE >= #since#
